integrity: The seven-word construction is treated as prior work. The exact upper bound, labeled equality census, and two Hamming-isometry orbits are reconstructed exhaustively by two independent descendant encodings and complete subset enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification only for binary length four and parent sets of size at most two under the coordinatewise descendant model. The later length-four construction paper was inspected at abstract/metadata level only, leaving a named residual bibliographic risk.
title: Complete classification of binary length-four two-separable codes
